items.requirement: Keep QueryFailureCode::StaleCursor and add the closed public CursorMismatchReason enum with QueryOptionsChanged and SourceViewChanged. QueryFailure::stale_cursor(reason) requires exactly one reason; expose it to SDK consumers and serialize a stable reason field in CLI diagnostics. No raw detail string or reuse of ViewScopeMismatch.
items.validation_order: After token syntax/version/integrity validation, compare normalized query binding first; mismatch is QueryOptionsChanged. Only if query binding matches, compare view digest; mismatch is SourceViewChanged. Malformed tokens/out-of-range positions remain typed invalid-argument failures, never mislabeled source changes.
items.recovery: Both may require a fresh query, but explanations distinguish changed options from changed source/view evidence; never echo private query values. Query-options recovery may suggest repeating the original options or removing the cursor; source-view recovery requires a fresh view.
items.proof: Baseline enum/constructor cases plus SDK continuation cases and CLI typed-reason/next-action cases distinguish the causes; changing only page size or available columns must not be asserted as source mutation.
